vocabulary.CHECKED_CONFIRMED: Opened. Supports the listed field values for the exact model.
vocabulary.CHECKED_PARTIAL: Opened. Supports some fields or models only. Remaining items stay open.
vocabulary.CHECKED_REJECTED: Opened. Does not support the held values. Values cleared to null.
vocabulary.CONFLICT: Opened, but sources or readings disagree. Values stay unchanged and the conflict is recorded.
vocabulary.INACCESSIBLE: Could not be opened from the sandbox. Nothing is inferred from it.
vocabulary.OPEN: Not yet opened (equivalent to NOT_CHECKED in the round-12 brief).

fieldOutcomeVocabulary.PROMOTED: Source states the value for the exact model; provenance promoted.
fieldOutcomeVocabulary.NOT_STATED: Source opened; it does not state this field. Stays CITED_IN_NOTES_UNCHECKED.
fieldOutcomeVocabulary.NOT_EXTRACTED: Source opened; the page containing the field did not extract to text. Stays open; retry.
fieldOutcomeVocabulary.SUPPORTED_NOT_PROMOTED: Source opened and supports the value, but the copy is distributor- or aggregator-hosted. driverCount/active allow only MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED, so the field stays CITED_IN_NOTES_UNCHECKED until the manufacturer host copy is checked (round 12b).

urls.document: QSC WideLine-8 Series Loudspeaker System User Manual, TD-000237-00 rev D (4 chunks)
urls.evidence: WL3082: "The WL3082 input connectors are a pair of Neutrik NL8's wired in parallel ... The WL3082 loudspeaker is not equipped with a crossover network. All signal processing must be done before connecting audio power to the loudspeaker." The manual documents only NL8/NL4 audio-power inputs, per-band nominal impedance and continuous power capacity; it lists no mains connection, no amplifier output rating and no gain/level control. WL212-sw: "The WL212-sw is equipped with two NL8 connectors with pins 1+ and 1- connected to the transducers", and "Its two ceramic magnet, 4" voice coil, 12" transducers provide 1100 watt continuous power handling capability." The subwoofer section never uses the words passive, active, powered or built-in amplification.

fieldResults.note: The exact-model QSC manual states that "audio power" is connected to the loudspeaker and that it has no crossover network or internal processing; the only inputs are NL8 audio-power connectors. This is an explicit statement of the external-amplification signal path, so the stored passive value is retained and re-sourced from the specification sheet to the manual.

Neither the specification sheet nor the user manual states passive/active or built-in amplification for the WL212-sw; the manual only describes the NL8/NL4 wiring to the transducers and a 1100 W continuous power-handling capability. Under the standing explicit-evidence rule the Round 22 manufacturer-verified promotion is retracted and the field returns to unknown.

fieldResults.note: The product is one loudspeaker chassis: the page prints a single nominal diameter, one magnet (type and weight), one voice coil (diameter and material), one cone and one basket. No second transducer or crossover is documented.

urls.document: Barefoot Sound MicroMain27 product page and TECH SPECS table
urls.evidence: Headline: "A 3.5-WAY ACTIVE STUDIO MONITOR WITH DUAL-FORCE™ AND MEME™ TECHNOLOGY"; body: "3.5-way active monitor", "1180 watts of power per monitor". TECH SPECS: Description "3.5-way active monitor with with Dual-Force™ and MEME™ Technologies"; Tweeter 1" ring radiator "Amplifier: 180W"; Midbass 1 and Midbass 2 5.25" cone, 250W each; Subwoofers "2 x 10" aluminum cone", 500W. The page also states "5 drive units" in its description of the model.

fieldResults.note: The exact model is described as an active monitor and every drive unit lists its own built-in amplifier (180 W, 250 W, 250 W, 500 W).
One 1" tweeter, two 5.25" midbass drivers and two 10" subwoofers: five driven transducers, matching the page's own "5 drive units" statement.

urls.document: Sonus faber Sonetto collection page, product cards
urls.evidence: The collection page's product cards read: Sonetto I - "A compact passive bookshelf speaker ideal for smaller listening environments"; Sonetto II - "A passive bookshelf speaker with a deeply enriched low end bass response". The page introduces the collection as "the second generation of the Sonetto Collection".

fieldResults.note: The exact model is described by the manufacturer as a passive bookshelf speaker. The record has no generation suffix; the first-generation owner's manual also declares the family a passive loudspeaker system, so both generations agree.
